justification: Soft-drop the Pre-DA Site History layer from the Intelligence Brief, frontend-only. Pre-DA needs a heavy ML dependency (torch/Tessera embeddings) the lean Railway web container cannot host, so it errored on every run and showed a permanent failure card. Hidden, not deleted: removed the 'Include site history' toggle, forced include_premium=false so the backend never runs pre-DA, removed it from the satellite expected-sections checklist, and filtered the satellite.pre_da_history section out of sectionEvents so the card never renders. All backend code and the frontend label/handler are retained; re-enable by removing the one filter + restoring the toggle (documented inline). No logic, query, or schema change.

break_it.scenario: Backend still emits a satellite.pre_da_history section event
break_it.what_happens: the card could reappear despite being dropped
break_it.repro: a brief run where the backend streams the pre_da_history section
break_it.how: sectionEvents is filtered to exclude satellite.pre_da_history before any render, progress checklist, or source collection, so the section is dropped regardless of what the backend emits

break_it.scenario: A user still wants site history and the option silently vanished
break_it.what_happens: a previously-available toggle is gone without explanation
break_it.repro: open the brief form and look for the site-history checkbox
break_it.how: the toggle only ever produced an error card (the layer could not run in this environment); hiding it removes a broken option rather than a working one, and the code is retained to restore once decoupled to a worker

break_it.scenario: Removing the includeSiteHistory state leaves a dangling reference
break_it.what_happens: a build/type error from an undefined identifier
break_it.repro: grep the file for includeSiteHistory / setIncludeSiteHistory
break_it.how: verified zero remaining references; include_satellite no longer ORs the removed flag and the effect dependency array was updated to match

post_merge.other_repo: N/A - frontend-only; backend pre_da_history code is untouched and simply never invoked (include_premium=false).
post_merge.manual_verify: Open the Intelligence Brief: the 'Include site history' checkbox is gone, the satellite checklist no longer lists Pre-DA Site History, and a completed brief shows no Pre-DA card (no error card).
